snippet.title: [AION 2] | Launch Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Take to the skies in the only MMORPG built for aerial battles. Ascend, and fight for your faction in AION 2. Launching globally this September. 

Wishlist Now on Steam
🪽 https://s.g.nc.com/s/5wOwP

AION 2 features a massive world built for thousands of players, true flight across land and sky, extensive character customization with deep cosmetic and dye systems, collectible pets, and faction-driven experiences that shape how you play.
